sources.note: Inspected owner-supplied carolina-elementary-school.png on 2026-10-08; capture date unknown. URL locates the site. Dense southwest, south and east canopy belts, northern classroom-gap crowns and isolated forecourt crowns. Broad tan courtyard stays bare; only the narrow visible green tongue gets grass, with small roof-end planted strips. Local west/north/south roof fits correct the old excessive shear. No distinguishable hedge separate from crowns. Crown-width observations: Broad west/south/east crowns about 65-85 px; isolated yard/classroom-end crowns about 30-55 px. Image roof sections matched separately to complete source roof corners; excluded opposite corners on distinct roofs provide independent checks. Mapped older roof sizes differ from imagery; sections are used independently rather than smoothing incompatible dimensions across the yard. Checks establish local roof-section accuracy, not a surveyed campus-wide transformation. Visible greenery is authored relative to its nearest matched section. Independent excluded check errors: 0.02 m, 0.33 m, 0.28 m, 0.39 m. Visible crown centers are fitted to clear trunks within the observed crown footprint (maximum seven metres); crowns may overhang roofs and roads. Crown widths in the dense belts are estimated from image pixels against their matched local roof scale; existing circular crowns approximate irregular/elliptical image crowns. Complete mapped roofs, pitches, full-width paths/roads, water and farmland remain unchanged. Planted islands take precedence over exposed paving; ground under opaque canopy is not invented. No surveyed boundary, species, construction date or exact inventory inferred; no bitmap ships.
